tasks.label: 🌿 Create Feature Branch
tasks.command: git checkout Dev; git pull origin main; git checkout -b feature/${input:ticketId}; git push -u origin feature/${input:ticketId}

tasks.label: 🔄 Sync Branch with Main
tasks.command: git fetch origin && git merge origin/main

tasks.label: ✅ Dry Run Deploy (Check Only)
tasks.command: sf project deploy start --manifest manifest/package.xml --dry-run --test-level RunLocalTests

tasks.label: 🧪 Run Apex Tests
tasks.command: sf apex run test --test-level RunLocalTests --result-format human --wait 10

tasks.label: 🔀 Create Promotion Branch
tasks.command: git checkout org-${input:targetEnv} && git pull origin org-${input:targetEnv} && git checkout -b promotion/${input:ticketId}-${input:targetEnv} && git push -u origin promotion/${input:ticketId}-${input:targetEnv}

tasks.label: 🔥 Create Hotfix Branch
tasks.command: git checkout main && git pull origin main && git checkout -b hotfix/${input:incidentId} && git push -u origin hotfix/${input:incidentId}

tasks.label: 🏥 Org Health Check
tasks.command: sf org display && sf apex run test --test-level RunLocalTests --result-format human --wait 10
